SELECT i.i_item_id, cust.ca_country, cust.ca_state, cust.ca_county, avg(cs.cs_quantity) AS agg1, avg(cs.cs_list_price) AS agg2, avg(cs.cs_coupon_amt) AS agg3, avg(cs.cs_sales_price) AS agg4, avg(cs.cs_net_profit) AS agg5, avg(cust.c_birth_year) AS agg6, avg(cd1.cd_dep_count) AS agg7
FROM catalog_sales cs
JOIN (SELECT d_date_sk FROM date_dim WHERE d_year = 2001) AS d ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
JOIN (SELECT cd_demo_sk, cd_dep_count FROM customer_demographics WHERE cd_gender = 'F' AND cd_education_status = 'Primary') AS cd1 ON cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk = cd1.cd_demo_sk
JOIN (
    SELECT c.c_customer_sk, c.c_birth_year, ca.ca_country, ca.ca_state, ca.ca_county
    FROM customer c
    JOIN (
        SELECT ca_address_sk, ca_country, ca_state, ca_county
        FROM customer_address
        WHERE ca_state IN ('AL','MO','TN','GA','MT','IN','CA')
    ) AS ca ON c.c_current_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    WHERE c.c_birth_month IN (1,3,7,11,10,4)
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM customer_demographics cd2
          WHERE c.c_current_cdemo_sk = cd2.cd_demo_sk
      )
) AS cust ON cs.cs_bill_customer_sk = cust.c_customer_sk
JOIN item i ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_id
GROUP BY GROUPING SETS (
    (cust.ca_country, cust.ca_state, cust.ca_county, i.i_item_id),
    (cust.ca_country, cust.ca_state, i.i_item_id),
    (cust.ca_country, i.i_item_id),
    (i.i_item_id),
    ()
)
ORDER BY cust.ca_country, cust.ca_state, cust.ca_county, i.i_item_id
LIMIT 100
